items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: I think it was the most unique outfit that I've ever seen... Ellington had to be a great politician to keep those guys, all of those drunks, in the band... Paul fell down, and Paul was sober as a judge, you know, he fell, he was on the stand.

ctx.x: And I could see this leg coming up off of the chair. This is Paul's chair. But I'm watching Ella out in front, you know, because I've got to watch her. And I saw Paul begin to lean over and lean over, and he was going.
